title: Marquise Drop Choker
category: Necklace: close collar choker with a fixed front Y-drop (sideways marquise station, fine chain, 2 pear drops)
metal: Lead: 18k gold tone (Gold variant, SKU YF7059: PVD 18K gold coating over surgical stainless steel), bright high polish, warm neutral yellow, the ribbed collar throwing fine stripes of light; never orange, brassy or rose. Alternate: rhodium silver tone (Silver variant, SKU YF7059-S; the tag says 'Rhodium Silver Tone Plated', the description says only 'silver tone', and PVD is stated for the gold only), cool bright white steel.
lock: 18k gold tone choker: 1 tightly ribbed round snake collar, 2mm thick, 41cm. At front, 1 clear marquise cubic zirconia, 12.3mm, in 4 claws, sideways on the collar. From it 1 fine chain falls about 4 marquise lengths, holding exactly 2 clear pear stones point up: 1 small halfway, 1 larger at the end. The marquise must stay horizontal along the collar, never vertical or a hanging pendant.
morph: The marquise orientation: image models stand it upright (point down, like a pendant) or hang it from a bail below the collar, when it really lies sideways, its points running along the collar line, gripped by 4 claws on the long sides. Second risks: the drop gains a 3rd stone or a cluster, the pears turn round or flip point-down, the two pears become the same size (the end one is clearly larger), or the drop stretches into a long lariat to the sternum. Third: the ribbed snake collar turns into a smooth wire, an omega, a cable or link chain, or thickens into a bold torque (the supplier calls it an 'Omega drop necklace', so never feed 'omega' to a model). Scale: earlier ads note colour/37 read too large; keep the marquise about the width of the hollow at the base of the throat.
sizeMm: Listed: 41cm plus 5cm extender; collar ribbed round snake chain about 2mm; marquise clear CZ about 12.3mm (its long side, set horizontal); drop 'approximately 6cm' with a small pear halfway and another at the end; weight about 9.3g. Measured from worn photo 02 using the 12.3mm marquise as the ruler (about 97 px): collar about 2.1mm; middle pear about 4.5 x 5.7mm; end pear about 5.3 x 7.1mm (roughly 1.3x the middle one); drop from under the marquise to the tip of the end pear about 4.2 to 4.5cm, i.e. about 4 marquise lengths, NOT 6cm. The size guide card (12) agrees with the photos: its drop arrow, labelled '14.7mm', measures about 45mm against its own 12.3mm marquise label, so the label is a typo for about 4.7cm and the description's 6cm overstates it (flag for a listing fix; avoid stating the drop length in ads). Body referent: worn, the collar sits snug at the base of the neck, the marquise sits in the hollow at the base of the throat (about its width), and the end pear lands about 2 to 3 finger-widths lower, on the top of the breastbone, well above any neckline.
claims: Waterproof, Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic (all three are tags; the description's care line also says 'Waterproof and tarnish free'). PVD 18K gold coating: Gold variant only. Surgical stainless steel (description). Not pre-order (no 'pre-order' tag).
copyNotes: Use: 'marquise', 'set sideways', 'pear drops' or 'two pear stones', 'clear cubic zirconia', 'ribbed snake collar', 'choker', 'close collar', 'fine drop', '18k gold tone', 'PVD' (gold only), 'silver tone' in customer copy (the description's word; 'rhodium silver tone' is tag-backed and fine in prompts), 'surgical stainless steel', 'waterproof', 'tarnish free', 'hypoallergenic', '41cm plus 5cm extender', price Rs 999 (compare-at Rs 1,429). Proven lines from the playbook: 'Close collar. / Long drop.' and, for the two-metal split, 'Warm or cool? / Wear both.' Avoid: bare 'gold' or 'solid gold' (the listing's 'Metal: Gold' reads as solid gold); 'diamond'; 'pendant' (the marquise is a station on the collar, not a hanging pendant); 'lariat' (it has a clasp and a fixed drop); 'omega', 'torque', 'tennis'; 'huggie'; any drop length in cm (listing 6cm vs photos about 4.5cm); 'PVD' or 'rhodium plated' for the silver in customer copy; implying the silver photos are photographs (all 5 are recolours); stale prices Rs 1,199 / Rs 2,388 from the 3 Nov listing.
story: One clean collar with one long thought: a snug ribbed line round the throat, a single marquise lying sideways like an eye at the base of the neck, and two pears falling from it like tears, or like raindrops running down a window. It is a choker with a plumb line: the drop points straight down the neckline, so it flatters every V, sweetheart and deep-back blouse and turns a plain slip or a white shirt open at the collar into an outfit. Rhymes: the marquise is the 'navette' (little boat) and the almond eye, so it rhymes with kajal-lined eyes, the nazar, and a tear; the ribbed collar looks like a stack of hair-thin bangles (a chooda for the neck) or a coiled telephone cord; the drop rhymes with a maang tikka (a tikka for the throat), a dew drop sliding off a leaf, the monsoon drip from a chajja, a pendulum, the pull chain of a lamp, a single 'I'. Big-stone drama, demi-fine price: Rs 999 for a piece that reads like a cocktail necklace, waterproof so it survives haldi water and holi-proof wipes. Two metals for warm or cool skin and gold-vs-silver outfits; gold leads (15 units and the only true photographs). Earlier best archetypes: OCCASION (haldi or sangeet, ads-20 score 8.07), WORN neckline, MACRO marquise in its claws, two-metal split, hanging plate (the drop against gravity).
variants: Gold (SKU YF7059) 15 units; Silver (SKU YF7059-S) 9 units; both Rs 999, compare-at Rs 1,429; option name 'Metal'. Listing media: 01 gold macro on a plaster cube (marquise, its claws, first pear; end pear cropped); 02 gold worn, front, base of the neck with an ivory satin cami (clearest scale and stone count); 03 gold macro of the marquise in its 4 claws on ivory, start of the drop; 04 gold worn close crop, bare shoulders; 05 gold laid on ivory, the collar arc, marquise and the full drop with both pears (clearest whole construction); 06 to 10 silver: the same five compositions as 01 to 05, recoloured with Higgsfield on 3 Nov (not photographs of a silver unit); 11 the blush Naira gift box, no piece; 12 size guide card with the supplier's gold photo (shows the back: lobster clasp and extender chain; text overlays, never a ref). Show gold. Show silver only beside gold (two-metal split), never alone, given 9 units and recoloured photos. Ref 1 = 05 (gold laid packshot), reusing the ads-500 media id for marquise-drop-choker__laid (pixel-identical); ref 2 = 02 (gold worn, for scale), newly imported.
